Phase 1 (rebar-debug) progress — diagnostic instrumentation dispatched.

Offline findings (no runtime proof yet):
- The DC codec produces well-formed, non-empty wiki for the exact test body: 'h1. <heading>

... *<bold>* ...

{code}
<code>
{code}
'. CREATE-path wire (backend.py:107 to_wire∘fit_outbound) and UPDATE-path wire (outbound_mapper.py:206 normalize_outbound∘fit_outbound) are BYTE-IDENTICAL for DC (decode_inbound is identity). So the wire the reconciler sends is correct — the defect is downstream of the wire.
- Both symptoms reduce to one: the rich description does not land a non-empty value on the DC issue (renderedFields=='' => empty source; settle pass re-emits => remote still differs from local). This is live-DC-only; arm64 cannot run the DC harness locally, and JIRA_URL is Cloud (ADF), not DC.

Decisive experiment (Gerrit change 2268, test-only): test_live_rich_text_direct_wire_probe PUTs the exact outbound-mapper wire straight through the transport (bypassing reconcile) and dumps raw stored + renderedFields read-back; the existing render test now also dumps the raw stored description. One live jira-dc-harness run discriminates a Jira-DC storage/renderer defect from a reconcile-applier defect. Will land the probe, run once, and confirm the root cause from the captured live values before writing any fix.
